definitions.explanation: Trees with needle-like or scale-like leaves, typically cone-bearing. Most are evergreen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{杉|すぎ}→杉：03889_sugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{針葉樹|しんようじゅ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{針葉樹|しんようじゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{育|そだ}ちます→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: Conifers can grow even in cold regions.

examples.japanese: {針葉樹|しんようじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一年中|いちねんじゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Coniferous forests are green all year round.

notes:
{針葉樹|しんようじゅ} refers to trees with needle-like leaves.

{針|しん} = needle, {葉|よう} = leaf, {樹|じゅ} = tree

Common Japanese conifers:
- ⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧ (pine)
- ⟦{杉|すぎ}→杉：03889_sugi⟧ (cedar)
- ⟦{檜|ひのき}→檜：04402_hinoki⟧ (cypress)
- ⟦{樅|もみ}→樅：noentry⟧ (fir)
- ⟦{唐松|からまつ}→唐松：28741_karamatsu⟧ (larch - a deciduous conifer)

Characteristics:
- Most are evergreen (except larch)
- Bear cones (⟦{松ぼっくり|まつぼっくり}→松ぼっくり：28720_matsubokkuri⟧ for pine cones)
- Needle-like leaves reduce water loss
- Softwood, used for construction

Opposite: ⟦{広葉樹|こうようじゅ}→広葉樹：04957_kouyouju⟧ (broadleaf trees)
